craft_notes: Sthāyin: elsewhere-joy. Close: sight (plainness). Rejected: 'ego' for ahaṃ — killed: I kept; 'states' flat — 'awarenesses' kept (saṃvit).

lines: I happy, I suffering, I attached and the like —
those awarenesses abide elsewhere, pleasure-strung, plain to sight.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ sukhī ca duḥkhī ca raktaś ca ityadisamvidaḥ | sukhādyavasthānusyūte vartante 'nyatra tāḥ sphuṭam

reads_against.argmap: I-happy, I-suffering, I-attached and the like: those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.
c1_essence: I-happy/suffering/attached awarenesses abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure.
